source: Build Policy Management list, detail, and employee edit flow from Figma

assumptions.text: The employee-centric John Doe Figma detail is placed under Policy Management with Policy Management selected, as approved.
The policy list had no supplied Figma frame, so policy metrics, filters, statuses, and sample rows follow the existing Claims page structure with policy-relevant content.
Figma blue links and green success states map to Compass primary link and Badge tokens rather than hardcoded colors.
The 974px Figma dialog maps to the nearest Compass container width sm:max-w-5xl, and its four-column table becomes stacked Field components on mobile.
View policy navigation and dialog interactions are functional; report, e-card, download, and endorsement submission controls remain presentational until backend flows are supplied.
The selected route policy number is dynamic while the remaining John Doe employee content follows the supplied Figma frame.
